subtitle: Campus visits & architecture
promotional_text: Plan your college visits: save the schools you like, tour every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 campus, do the campus traditions, and collect stamps in school colors.
whats_new:
Plan your college visits
• 101 university campuses: every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 school, plus the Ivy League and more, grouped by conference.
• My College List: tap the heart on any campus to save the schools you're thinking about.
• College Road Trip: one trip with a day at each school, in a short driving order, then tour it in 3D.
• Plan a Campus Visit: a one-day walking tour of a campus's landmarks.
• Campus traditions: over 250 to do or see, like rubbing a statue for luck or ringing a bell.
• Campus stamps now come in school colors.
• New achievements for campus traditions and for stamping every campus in a conference.

Also new
• Find campuses by nickname, like "UGA", "Ole Miss" or "Hokies".
• A Stay filter shows hotels on the map, and Find Hotels opens a hotel search for your trip dates.
• Buildings with no known architect or style no longer show "Unknown".
• Checked and corrected campus details, and better buildings on many campuses.
description:
Stamped! turns the world's great buildings into a passport to fill. Explore more than 1,800 architectural landmarks in 140 cities and 101 university campuses, earn a stamp for every one you visit, and fly through real cities on a photoreal 3D map.

PLAN YOUR COLLEGE VISITS
• 101 campuses: every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 school, the Ivy League, and great campuses around the world
• Save the schools you're considering to My College List
• Make a College Road Trip: a day at each school, in a short driving order
• Plan a Campus Visit: a one-day walking tour of a campus's landmarks
• Find hotels near campus for each night of your trip

CAMPUS TRADITIONS
• Over 250 campus traditions to do or see, from lucky statues to bells and famous gates
• Check them off as you go and earn the Traditions Keeper badge
• Campus stamps in school colors

PLAN ANY TRIP
• Plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places
• Reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route
• Fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day
• Your trips and college list sync with iCloud

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D city and campus maps with satellite imagery
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark
• Look Around previews of the streets before you go
• Map filters for food, coffee, culture and places to stay

COLLECT STAMPS
• Earn a passport stamp for every landmark you visit
• Follow your progress on the world map, by city, country and conference
• Unlock achievements and share your passport
• See your progress at a glance with the Home Screen widget

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for every building
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city and campus
• Search by name, architect or campus nickname

Available in 9 languages, with high-contrast and reduced-motion options.

Stamped! is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. School names and colors are used only to identify them.
